speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: The social needs of our citizens and families are becoming more complex as the demographics, economics and family structures in Singapore change.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Our social policies and services must evolve so that we can continue to nurture resilient individuals and strong families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Our societal culture must also evolve so that we can become a more inclusive and caring society where no Singaporean is left behind.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: The family must remain the basic building block of our society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: The Ministry is committed to making Singapore a great place for families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will work with Government agencies, businesses and employers, as well as community organisations, to create a conducive environment for Singaporeans to start families and raise children, enjoy family life and experience meaningful family ties.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will provide greater support for couples to prepare for and strengthen their marriages and offer evidence-based parenting programmes in our schools and community.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: These will include marriage preparation and support programmes for young couples and Singaporeans marrying foreigners.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: MSF will also strengthen support for vulnerable families so that they can overcome their challenges and become more stable and resilient.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will look into new ways of engaging such families early and work with social service agencies to assess their needs holistically to provide more coordinated and effective assistance.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: The Ministry will strive towards giving all our young children a good start in life.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will extend greater attention and support to those from disadvantaged or vulnerable backgrounds so that they, too, can realise their potential.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: ECDA will provide parents with more good quality and affordable childcare options through its Anchor Operator and Partner Operator schemes.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: It will also continue to enhance the quality of preschool education and the professional development of early childhood educators.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: To help vulnerable children from low-income or disadvantaged families, we will work with other Government agencies and community organisations to identify them and support their developmental needs during their early years.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will also introduce initiatives to help these families improve their home environment for the children's learning and development, as well as support the children at pre-schools.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: For children who need protection or care outside of their own homes, we will broaden the care options available to them.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: This will include working with VWOs and volunteers to increase the number of foster families who can offer a nurturing environment for these children to grow up in.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: To better help youths-at-risk, we will strengthen both Government and community systems, programmes and capabilities in prevention, early intervention and rehabilitation.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Page: 49 Those with less and those in need will receive an extra helping hand to overcome their difficulties and improve their lives.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Building on their reach on the ground, SSOs will further improve the coordination in planning and delivery of social services for residents within each HDB town.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will also expand SSNet to cover more help agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Together, these efforts will ensure that Singaporeans with complex social support needs receive more holistic and integrated help.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Through assistance in early intervention, education, training and employment, we will help them maximise their potential at different stages of their lives.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will also render greater support for caregivers.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will work with employers, businesses, community organisations and volunteers to raise public understanding and acceptance of persons with disabilities within our communities.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: To safeguard the interests of the growing number of the elderly in Singapore, the Government will review legislations, policies and services to better protect those who are subject to abuse, neglect or self-neglect.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will also look into strengthening support for vulnerable adults in residential care through streamlining regulatory and care standards for residential homes.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: The future of caring in Singapore is one where Singaporeans come together to look out for and support one another, especially those amongst us who need a helping hand.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Government agencies, VWOs, corporates, community organisations, social service professionals and the wider public all play a part.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Through what we do and how we do it, the Ministry hopes to nurture a culture and spirit of giving in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: Professionals, including early childhood educators, learning support specialists, social workers, counsellors, therapists, psychologists and care workers, lie at the forefront of the social service sector.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: We will also expand opportunities for them to develop their capabilities and build fulfilling careers.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
text: VWOs play a critical role in mobilising volunteers and donors to complement the work of social service professionals and the effort of the Government.
